what: ALK, short for anaplastic lymphoma kinase, is a gene.
ALK amplifications, fusions and mutations have been shown to be driving events in non-small cell lung cancer.
intro.test_report: If a test report mentions ALK, it is recording a finding about this gene. This page lists public FDA companion diagnostics that look for ALK, and the therapies and trials in this snapshot that use ALK as a selection criterion. That mention is not a diagnosis or a treatment decision on its own.

lines.text: Alectinib (Alecensa) is a kinase inhibitor. The FDA label lists this use: adjuvant treatment in adult patients following tumor resection of anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) (tumors ≥ 4 cm or node positive) as detected by an FDA-approved test. treatment of adult patients with ALK-positive metastatic NSCLC as detected by an FDA-approved test. 1.1 Adjuvant Treatme. An EMA record for Alecensa lists the status as Authorised, with an authorisation date of 15/12/2016.

Brigatinib (Alunbrig) is a kinase inhibitor. The FDA label lists this use: the treatment of adult patients with anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) as detected by an FDA-approved test ALUNBRIG is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of adult patients with anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCL. An EMA record for Alunbrig lists the status as Authorised, with an authorisation date of 19/09/2018.

Ceritinib (ZYKADIA) is a kinase inhibitor. The FDA label lists this use: the treatment of adult patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) whose tumors are anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive as detected by an FDA-approved test ZYKADIA is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of adults with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) whose tumors are anaplastic lym. An EMA record for Zykadia lists the status as Authorised, with an authorisation date of 26/02/2015.

Ensartinib (ENSACOVE) is a kinase inhibitor. The FDA label lists this use: the treatment of adult patients with anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)as detected by an FDA-approved test who have not previously received an ALK-inhibitor. ENSACOVE is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of adult patients with anaplastic lymph.
